messages:
maria: quick bench dump — L4 vs T4 vs A10G for embeddings and small-chat across us-east1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1. TL;DR: A10G wins latency, L4 best cost for embeddings at 99% quant q8_0, T4 middle ground for small-chat.

jon: can you paste numbers? :eyes:

maria: pasted below — these are p50/p95 lat (ms) and throughput (req/s) at single request concurrency on 512-token chat / 768-dim embed. quant = q8_0 for embeddings, q4_0 for chat.

maria: ```
# us-east1
A10G - embed: p50 6ms p95 18ms tp=1100/s cost_core=$0.35/1Memb
T4   - embed: p50 9ms p95 30ms tp=700/s cost_core=$0.22/1Memb
L4   - embed: p50 5ms p95 20ms tp=1200/s cost_core=$0.14/1Memb

A10G - chat: p50 28ms p95 120ms tp=85/s cost_core=$1.5/1Mtok
T4   - chat: p50 40ms p95 180ms tp=60/s cost_core=$1.0/1Mtok
L4   - chat: p50 55ms p95 260ms tp=45/s cost_core=$0.65/1Mtok
```

maria: Kernel notes: for L4 we hit optimized fp16 matmul kernel (custom fused attention) => great embed perf. T4 needs patched cuBLAS path for q8 perf. A10G benefits from amx-accel and memory bandwidth for chat.

alex: nice. do we have regional variance? eu-west1 showed +10-20% p95 on T4 due to node noisy neighbour.

sam: for capacity planning: recommendation: embeddings heavy workload => pack 6 L4/gpu (batching) yields ~6.5k embed/s per pod. For chat low-latency => A10G reserved pools, 8 concurrent streams per GPU gives stable p95 under target.

linh: any quality regression with quant? q8_0 for emb had 0.8% recall drop on our eval set, q4_0 for chat showed occasional tokenization trunc artifacts in prompts with emojis.

jon: thanks. action items: 1) run longer 24h stability on eu-west T4 nodes (ci-bot can schedule) 2) add q8 eval to nightly for embeddings 3) update deploy playbook with region fallback to A10G if p95 exceeds 200ms.
